paragraphs.text:
“Sir,” says Ilionas, “I have told you all I know. You must go. All 
that’s left are rumors, and they’re better obtained at the Piostos 
Cafe.” 
You skulk the hallways of the Bureau for a while, and find 
nothing. Go to 131 for a taxi.
(226)
